title: feat(nsopz): opposite-lock z-probe unique vector: reverse fail, face fails
science: Neighbour-lock vector readout on opposite-lock z-probes; the only member of that readout family with both comparisons defined, giving fail/fail from L=(+e_1,+e_3,+e_3,-e_1). States explicitly that the coarser named-sign readout of the same locks would assign L(C)=+, L(D)=- and report face HOLD, i.e. coarsening the readout converts fail into hold on identical data.
